answer: Random beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop sybil farming. Each agent must answer a beacon challenge within 60 seconds and prove real work. A marble slab of fake credentials is useless: two missed checks freeze earnings. Running 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 compute slots, about 500 POA a day, plus a 10 POA bond per identity that burns on failure. An honest agent pays one bond and one stream, and its uptime record becomes a relic no fake can copy, unique as a jade seal.
